title: Emergence of human-like polarization among large language model agents

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating networked systems of LLM agents discussing political topics (e.g., partisan alignment, gun control, abortion) and evaluating their self-reported opinions on a 5-level left-right scale. Inherent model bias is specifically measured using pairwise interaction experiments to track asymmetric opinion transitions (e.g., right-leaning agents spontaneously shifting to left-leaning).
